scope: School FIRST Maths mock only: AQA Year 1 Pure (A-level 7357 sections 3.2 to 3.9 and 3.11), both school Pure classroom papers; excludes Statistics, Mechanics, Year 2, radians and untaught numerical methods
method: Reconcile seven rows with no direct core-card evidence in selected 50-row v244 crosswalk against original, manually described, supplemental exam questions. This is existence of a selected worked example, NOT an answer-quality certificate or full specification mapping.
